svg.title: ITIL 4
svg.desc: ITIL 4. IT service management with ITIL 4: the service value system, guiding principles and change enablement that work with DevOps, not against it. Step 1, One board for every change: Before: every change waits about 3 days for a weekly CAB that approves 39 of 40, yet 15% still fail. Step 2, The service value system: The service value system: CHG-2420 flows from request to value, shaped by four guiding principles. Step 3, Change enablement: Change enablement: 85% of changes are standard and run in 2 hours; the CAB keeps the risky few. Step 4, Common pitfalls: Pitfalls: ITIL copied as a rulebook, not adapted, a CMDB as the goal, ITIL vs DevOps, certificates.

g.text: Before: every change waits about 3 days for a weekly CAB that approves 39 of 40, yet 15% still fail.
The service value system: CHG-2420 flows from request to value, shaped by four guiding principles.
Change enablement: 85% of changes are standard and run in 2 hours; the CAB keeps the risky few.
Pitfalls: ITIL copied as a rulebook, not adapted, a CMDB as the goal, ITIL vs DevOps, certificates.
